Definition: Magor-mis-Sabib, a symbolic name of Pashur
BiblicalUsage: Magor-missabib = "terror on every side"; 1) the name given Pashur the priest by Jeremiah when Pashur smote him and put him in the stocks for prophesying against the idolatry of Jerusalem
